cycle_improvement.description: Ported NBA's GA-tunable LR regularization to political alpha. Changed logistic_regression model from static C=1.0 + saga solver to C=1/reg_lambda (GA-tunable via existing hyperparam) + lbfgs solver. Political's LR was static — the GA could not tune its regularization. Now reg_lambda controls LR smoothness, same as NBA.
